_about: Firestore reads/writes per user action, derived from the real code paths (see tests/load/quota-budget.md). Firestore bills 1 read per document returned (min 1 per query) and 1 read per up-to-1000 index entries for count() aggregations. Formulas use the 'assumptions' below; scripts/quota-budget.mjs evaluates them.

studentDashboardLoad.where: js/student.js loadEverything() + getHiddenSectionIds() + js/assignment-cache.js (assignments, own submissions, term caches)
studentDashboardLoad.note: enrollments + sections every load; subjects/settings only on a 30-min term-cache miss; only the assignments a teacher added/edited since the cached copy (per-assignment assignmentVersions map on the section, documentId 'in' query); own submissions only for sections whose enrollment.subsVersion changed. A whole-class refetch happens only on first load, the 6h TTL, or legacy sections not yet backfilled.

studentSubmit.where: js/student.js submit form -> addDoc/updateDoc + afterOwnSubmissionWrite(), then loadEverything() reload
studentSubmit.note: the reload re-reads enrollments and only the touched section's submissions; writes = the submission + the student's own enrollment.subsVersion stamp

teacherHomeLoad.where: js/teacher.js loadSubjects() + getNotifications() + getMissingWorkCounts() (structure cached 10 min, missing-work 15 min, inbox fresh)
teacherHomeLoad.note: a Home visit with warm caches: 3 term settings + subjects list + inbox (pending submissions, leave/join/seen/redo enrollments)

teacherGradeAssignment.note: one fetch of the class's submissions (+assignment, quiz key/attempts), 2 reads per review opened, +1 read +1 write per publish for touchStudentSubs() (enrollment.subsVersion). Publish re-renders and updates the bell from memory.

teacherStructureRefresh.note: first visit / after 10-15 min / after own structural edits: sections + assignments + two count() per section + one count() per current-term past-due assignment
